# Models and studies

**Role:** reference
**Status:** generated by `python -m femkit schema docs` — do not edit
**Authority:** none of its own; the schema models are the authority for `<project>/model.toml` and `<project>/studies/<study>/study.toml` (models.md § 3, § 5)

## ModelFile

`model.toml`: the physics, and nothing about an engine (models.md § 3).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `1` | required | this file's shape; raised when it changes |
| `formulation` | text, optional | — | one formulation ID (models.md § 4) |
| `parameters` | table of text → text | empty | each named quantity, or an expression of the ones above it. A quantity with its unit, or an expression of parameters |
| `frame` | [Frame](#frame), optional | — | the coordinates' unit |
| `geometry` | [Geometry](#geometry), optional | — | the dimension, its meaning, the shapes |
| `regions` | table of text → [Region](#region) | empty | each named region |
| `materials` | table of text → table of text → [Property](#property) | empty | each material, by its properties |
| `assign` | table of text → text | empty | a material for each domain region. Refers by name to its keys: region:domain, its values: material |
| `conventions` | [Conventions](#conventions), optional | — | the conventions the formulation requires |
| `conditions` | table of text → [Condition](#condition) | empty | a condition for each outer boundary and named interface. Refers by name to its keys: region:boundary or region:interface |
| `radiation` | [Radiation](#radiation), optional | — | for an open problem |
| `sources` | table of text → [Source](#source) | empty | each excitation, by name |

## Frame

The coordinates' frame: Cartesian, right-handed, its origin where coordinates are zero.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | text | required | the length unit a bare-number coordinate is in. A unit |

## Geometry

The dimension, what it means for the formulation, and the shapes.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dimension` | `2` \| `3`, optional | — | 2 or 3 |
| `meaning` | text, optional | — | what this dimension means, one of the formulation's (`per unit depth`) |
| `shapes` | table of text → [Rectangle](#rectangle) or [Disk](#disk) or [Polygon](#polygon) or [Box](#box) or [Sphere](#sphere) or [Cylinder](#cylinder) or [Extrusion](#extrusion) or [Combined](#combined) or [Imported](#imported) | empty | each shape by name |

## Rectangle

An axis-aligned rectangle (2-D).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `rectangle` | required | what shape it is |
| `corner` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its lower corner. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `size` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its width and height. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Disk

A disk (2-D).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `disk` | required | what shape it is |
| `center` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its center. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `radius` | integer or Decimal or text | required | its radius. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Polygon

A polygon (2-D), its vertices in order.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `polygon` | required | what shape it is |
| `points` | list of list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its vertices. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Box

An axis-aligned box (3-D).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `box` | required | what shape it is |
| `corner` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its lower corner. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `size` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its extent along each axis. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Sphere

A sphere (3-D).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `sphere` | required | what shape it is |
| `center` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its center. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `radius` | integer or Decimal or text | required | its radius. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Cylinder

A cylinder (3-D): the center of one end, its axis (length and direction), its radius.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `cylinder` | required | what shape it is |
| `base` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | the center of one end. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `axis` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | from that end to the other. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `radius` | integer or Decimal or text | required | its radius. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Extrusion

A planar polygon swept along a vector (3-D).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `extrusion` | required | what shape it is |
| `profile` | list of list of integer or Decimal or text | required | the polygon's vertices, in one plane. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `along` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | the sweep. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Combined

The union, difference (the first less the others) or intersection of named shapes.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `union` \| `difference` \| `intersection` | required | what shape it is |
| `of` | list of text | required | the shapes, by name. Refers by name to shape |

## Imported

A CAD file the person supplies, under `custom/`, with its SHA-256.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `import` | required | what shape it is |
| `file` | text | required | its path under the project's `custom/` |
| `sha256` | text | required | its SHA-256 |

## Region

A named domain, outer boundary or interface, selected by exactly one rule (models.md § 3).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `domain` \| `boundary` \| `interface` | required | a domain, an outer boundary or an interface |
| `shapes` | list of text, optional | — | the named shapes. Refers by name to shape |
| `plane` | [Plane](#plane), optional | — | the outer faces on this plane |
| `box` | [Window](#window), optional | — | the outer faces inside this box |
| `faces_of` | text, optional | — | the outer faces of this shape. Refers by name to shape |
| `rest` | `True`, optional | — | the outer faces no other region selects |
| `between` | list of text, optional | — | the two domains it lies between. Refers by name to region:domain |

## Plane

A plane: a point on it and its normal.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `point` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | a point on it. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `normal` | list of integer or Decimal | required | its normal, a direction |

## Window

An axis-aligned box that selects the boundaries inside it.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `corner` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its lower corner. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `size` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | its extent. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |

## Property

One material property: a constant or a table, with what it rests on (models.md § 3).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | text, optional | — | a constant, with its unit where it has one. A quantity with its unit, or an expression of parameters |
| `table` | text, optional | — | a table under `custom/`: the variable, then the value's real and imaginary parts |
| `sha256` | text, optional | — | the table's SHA-256 |
| `variable` | [Variable](#variable), optional | — | the table's independent variable |
| `interpolation` | `linear`, optional | — | between the table's rows |
| `convention` | `real` \| `exp(-iwt)` \| `exp(+iwt)`, optional | — | the complex-value convention of the source data |
| `source` | text, optional | — | where the data comes from |
| `range` | `all` or list of text, optional | — | where it is valid: `all`, or `[from, to]` in its variable. A quantity with its unit, or an expression of parameters |

## Variable

The independent variable of a tabulated property.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | required | what it is (`wavelength`) |
| `unit` | text | required | the unit its column is in. A unit |

## Conventions

What the formulation requires to be chosen; never defaulted.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phasor` | `exp(-iwt)` \| `exp(+iwt)`, optional | — | the phasor's time factor |
| `amplitude` | `peak` \| `rms`, optional | — | whether amplitudes are peak or RMS |

## Condition

What holds on a boundary or interface.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | text | required | one of the formulation's kinds |

## Radiation

For an open problem: where waves leave, and the medium beyond.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boundaries` | list of text | required | the outer boundaries waves leave through. Refers by name to region:boundary |
| `background` | text, optional | — | the medium beyond them. Refers by name to material |

## Source

An excitation, attached to a region.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | text | required | one of the formulation's kinds |
| `on` | text | required | the region it acts in or on. Refers by name to region |

## StudyFile

`studies/<study>/study.toml`: everything that is not the physics (models.md § 5).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `1` | required | this file's shape; raised when it changes |
| `display` | list of text | empty | units numbers are shown in, the first of each dimension. A unit |
| `numerics` | [Numerics](#numerics), optional | — | the numerics every case shares |
| `axes` | table of text → [Axis](#axis) or text | empty | each axis, keyed by the case path it varies; `reason`: why axes of different classes are crossed |
| `observables` | table of text → [Observable](#observable) | empty | each observable, by name |
| `environments` | table of text → [Binding](#binding) | empty | each engine environment's bindings |

## Numerics

Everything numerical that is not an environment's own choice.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `element` | [Element](#element), optional | — | the element family and degree |
| `geometry_order` | integer, optional | — | the order of the geometry's elements |
| `mesh` | [Mesh](#mesh), optional | — | the mesh policy |
| `solver` | [Solver](#solver), optional | — | the linear solver |

## Element

The element family and its degree.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `family` | text | required | `lagrange`, `nedelec`, …: mapped per environment (models.md § 6.4) |
| `degree` | integer | required | its polynomial degree |

## Mesh

The mesh policy (models.md § 6.5).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | text, optional | — | the length unit geometry is handed to the mesher in. A unit |
| `size` | text, optional | — | the largest element size. A length |
| `regions` | table of text → text | empty | a size for each named region. Refers by name to its keys: region. A length |

## Solver

The linear solver.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `direct` \| `iterative` | required | direct or iterative |
| `tolerance` | text, optional | — | an iterative solver's relative tolerance, a plain number. A quantity with its unit, or an expression of parameters |

## Axis

What one axis varies, keyed by the case path it varies.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `class` | `numerical convergence` \| `geometry convergence` \| `physical sweep` | required | its class (models.md § 5) |
| `values` | list of integer or Decimal or text | required | the values, in order. A quantity with its unit, or an expression of parameters |

## Observable

A number the study reports (models.md § 5).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quantity` | text | required | a quantity the formulation derives |
| `support` | [Support](#support) | required | where it is read |
| `reduction` | `value` \| `average` \| `integral` \| `maximum` \| `norm` | required | how it is reduced |
| `unit` | text, optional | — | the unit it is reported in. A unit |
| `side` | text, optional | — | on an interface, the domain it is read from. Refers by name to region:domain |

## Support

Where an observable is read: a point, a line, or a region.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `point` | list of integer or Decimal or text, optional | — | a point. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `line` | list of list of integer or Decimal or text, optional | — | a line, from its first point to its second. A bare number in the frame's unit, or a length |
| `region` | text, optional | — | a region. Refers by name to region |

## Binding

What a study binds for one environment (models.md § 5).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resources` | [Resources](#resources), optional | — | its job's resources (jobs.md § 2) |

## Resources

What a job asks for; nothing about a machine (jobs.md § 2).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ranks` | integer | required | MPI ranks |
| `threads` | integer | required | threads per rank |
| `gpus` | integer | required | GPUs per node, a count; 0 states that none is used |
| `wall` | text, optional | — | wall time, `[D-]HH:MM:SS`; read on a machine with a scheduler |
| `memory` | text, optional | — | memory per node, a whole number with `K`, `M`, `G` or `T`; read on a machine with a scheduler |
| `partition` | text, optional | — | the queue, on a machine with a scheduler |
| `qos` | text, optional | — | the quality of service, where the record lists one |
